description: Fails when a writing tool under tool/data/ (manifest surface remote-write or remote-destructive) does not record its applied runs in dataToolRuns through tool/data/lib/run_record.mjs. Tools that predate the helper are listed as legacy, and the list only shrinks.

rules.title: Writing data tools record each applied run
rules.instruction: A tool under tool/data/ that writes to Firestore wraps its apply phase in withRunRecord from tool/data/lib/run_record.mjs, so dataToolRuns holds the tool, commit, project, counts and times of every applied run. Dry runs write nothing. Remove a legacy tool from the check's list when it adopts the helper.
